description: One call, the best current answer for a whole stack: a list of items (kind vps: vcpu, ram_gb, disk_gb, region, term, currency, count; kind gpu: gpu, count, hours_per_month, region, gpus_per_instance; kind llm or inference: model, input_mtok, output_mtok, count). Per item the 5 cheapest offers with a verified price (the free ordering: price only, nothing for money), the monthly cost for your count and usage (a stated unit price times your quantities, nothing estimated), verified_at, source_url and a scope line; an item with no fresh match says so. Totals per currency, never converted. Same answer as POST /v1/quote. Free: 3 quotes a day per address; beyond that 1 credit per quote on an API key (see /pricing). Reads prices, and records the free quote or credit it uses (so it is not read-only). Pass an idempotency_key to retry without a second charge. Returns an error object (HTTP 402 body) when out of credits.

idempotency_key.description: 1 to 128 characters; the same key never charges twice (API key callers)
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
